title: Newsletter from scratch
promise: Capture ideas, draft an issue, add a header image and send it to your first subscribers.
time: About 3 hours for the first issue
audience: Writers and makers starting an audience of their own

steps.title: Capture ideas as notes
steps.why: Obsidian keeps notes as plain Markdown files on your own disk, so your archive is yours whatever happens to the app. It is free for personal use.

steps.title: Draft the issue
steps.why: Google Docs is handy for a first draft because you can share it for comments before it goes out.

steps.title: Pick a header image
steps.why: Unsplash photos are free to use; choose one that says something about the issue instead of a generic stock feel.

steps.title: Send it
steps.why: Buttondown is a plain, writer-friendly newsletter tool with a free tier while your list is small.
